name: What painting challenges occur in older bathrooms around Denver and Englewood?

mainEntity.name: What painting challenges occur in older bathrooms around Denver and Englewood?

acceptedAnswer.text: In older Denver and Englewood homes, common challenges include old oil-based paints, plaster walls, and inadequate mechanical exhaust fans. Many historic bathrooms feature heavy plaster that holds moisture differently than modern drywall, requiring specialized breathable or stain-blocking primers. Additionally, older homes often have coats of glossy oil paint that must be fully degreased, scuff-sanded, and coated with a bonding primer before latex can stick. Homes lacking exterior exhaust venting require higher-sheen, mildew-resistant paints to compensate for persistent humidity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older homes often have legacy oil-based paint, plaster surfaces, or weak ventilation, requiring bonding primers, plaster repairs, and moisture-resistant finishes.
